title: Warehouse & logistics
description: Shipment status, damage and safety answers that check the system before promising dates.

train.prompt: A customer asks where their parcel is.
train.completion: Check the tracking number in the shipment system and give the latest scan and expected delivery date it shows.

train.prompt: A pallet arrived with crushed boxes.
train.completion: Take photos, note the damage on the delivery receipt before signing, and open a damage claim with the carrier.

train.prompt: Can we promise next-day delivery to an island address?
train.completion: Check the carrier's service area and cut-off times for that postcode. Many remote addresses need extra days.

train.prompt: A forklift is leaking oil in aisle 4.
train.completion: Stop using the forklift, block the area, clean the spill with the spill kit and report the forklift for repair.

train.prompt: The system shows 40 units but the shelf has 32.
train.completion: Do a recount, check for open picks or misplaced stock, and record a stock adjustment if the difference is confirmed.

train.prompt: A customer wants to change the delivery address after dispatch.
train.completion: Check whether the carrier allows a redirect for this shipment. If it does, request it and tell the customer about any fee.

train.prompt: An order needs dangerous goods labels. Who can pack it?
train.completion: Only staff trained in dangerous goods can pack it. Check the training list and use the correct labels and documents.

train.prompt: The truck for the 3pm collection has not arrived.
train.completion: Contact the carrier for the new arrival time, and tell customer service which orders will be delayed.

train.prompt: A parcel was marked delivered but the customer did not get it.
train.completion: Check the proof of delivery photo and signature. If it was not delivered, open a lost parcel claim with the carrier.

train.prompt: Can I lift a 35 kg box on my own?
train.completion: No. Use a lifting aid or ask a colleague for a team lift, following the manual handling rules.

train.prompt: A customer wants a refund for a late delivery.
train.completion: Check the delivery promise for their shipping option. If the guaranteed date was missed, refund the shipping fee as the policy allows.

train.prompt: We received stock without a purchase order number.
train.completion: Hold the stock in the receiving area, contact purchasing to find the order, and do not put it away until it is matched.

val.prompt: A customer asks if their parcel will arrive before Christmas.
val.completion: Check the tracking and the carrier's holiday cut-off dates before giving any date.

val.prompt: The fire exit in the loading bay is blocked by pallets.
val.completion: Move the pallets right away, because fire exits must always stay clear, and report it to the shift manager.

val.prompt: An order was picked with the wrong colour item.
val.completion: Stop the shipment if it has not left, swap the item, and record the picking error.

val.prompt: A carrier wants us to sign for 10 pallets but only 9 arrived.
val.completion: Write 9 pallets received on the delivery note before signing and report the missing pallet to the carrier.
